description: Figure 3 (“Results of Ablation Study”) presents two side-by-side grouped bar charts that illustrate ablation results for two datasets, with each chart showing model variants as separate bars and reporting performance as accuracy. In both panels, the horizontal axis contains categorical method variants (rotated labels) and the vertical axis is labeled “Acc (%)” with a linear scale spanning approximately 75 to 95, with evenly spaced tick marks at about 2.5-point intervals. The left panel is titled “PHEME” and contains six vertical bars: a dark red bar labeled “DAE (Ours)” at about 89.8, an orange bar “w/o cognitive empathy” at about 87.2, a pale yellow bar “w/o emotion” at about 84.8, a light blue bar “w/o comment selection” at about 88.9, a medium blue bar “w/o text” at about 87.3, and a dark blue bar “w/o comments” at about 88.0; each bar has its numeric value printed above it. The right panel is titled “PolitiFact” and also contains six vertical bars in the same color order and labeling: dark red “DAE (Ours)” at about 90.6, orange “w/o cognitive empathy” at about 90.0, pale yellow “w/o emotion” at about 84.9, light blue “w/o comment selection” at about 89.6, medium blue “w/o text” at about 83.0, and dark blue “w/o comments” at about 87.8, again with values annotated above the bars. The bars are grouped by dataset (two separate panels) rather than stacked, there is no legend shown (colors differentiate bars within each panel), and the categories appear in a fixed method-variant order rather than being sorted by bar height; no bars are specially outlined or otherwise emphasized beyond the value labels.
